df <- data.frame(
  condition = c(
    "H(S)\nNone",
    "H(S|pause)\nPause",
    "H(S|dur)\nDuration",
    "H(S|W)\nText",
    "H(S|W,pause)\nPause + Text",
    "H(S|W,dur)\nDuration + Text",
        "H(S)\nNone",
    "H(S|pause)\nPause",
    "H(S|dur)\nDuration",
    "H(S|W)\nText",
    "H(S|W,pause)\nPause + Text",
    "H(S|W,dur)\nDuration + Text"
  ),
  nats_seq = c(59.7,58.9,50.3,15.5,14.7,15.6,
               42.2, 40.6, 40.4, 4.41, 4.66, 5.34
  ),
  stdev = c(0.65, 0.81, 0.67, 0.11, 0.14, 0.25,
            0.39, 0.57, 0.67, 0.03, 0.09, 0.16
  ),
  mi = c(NaN, 0.83, 9.43, 44.2, NaN, NaN,
         NaN, 1.64, 1.82, 37.8, NaN, NaN
  ),
  mi_given_text = c(NaN, NaN, NaN, NaN, 0.84, -0.15,
                    NaN, NaN, NaN, NaN, -0.26, -0.93
  ),
  dataset = c("LibriTTS","LibriTTS","LibriTTS","LibriTTS","LibriTTS","LibriTTS",
              "CANDOR","CANDOR","CANDOR","CANDOR","CANDOR","CANDOR" )
)

get_label <- function(mi, word_context = FALSE) {
  out <- character(length(mi))   # always return a character vector
  
  # non-NaN positions
  ok <- !is.nan(mi)
  
  if (word_context) {
    out[ok] <- sprintf("MI(X,S|W) = %.1f", mi[ok])
  } else {
    out[ok] <- sprintf("MI(X,S) = %.1f", mi[ok])
  }
  
  out
}


df$mi_label <- get_label(df$mi)
df$mi_text_label <- get_label(df$mi_given_text, word_context=TRUE)


# Order factors for prettier plotting
# df$condition <- factor(df$condition, levels = df$condition)

plot1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = condition, y = nats_seq, fill=dataset)) +
  geom_col(position=position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = nats_seq - stdev,
      ymax = nats_seq + stdev
    ),
    width = 0.25,
    linewidth = 0.4,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("LibriTTS" = "#556B8F", "CANDOR" = "#E28F41")) +
  #geom_text(aes(y = nats_seq + stdev + 0.8, label = mi_label), size = 3.2) +
  #geom_text(aes(y = nats_seq + stdev + 2.0, label = mi_text_label), size = 3.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits=c(0, 65),
    breaks = seq(0, 65, by = 10),
    ) +
  labs(
    x = "Input",
    y = "Entropy (nats per sequence)",
    fill = "Dataset",
    title = "Syntactic Entropy by Input Modality and Read vs. Spontaneous Speech",
  ) +
  # geom_hline(yintercept=61.39, linetype="dashed") +
  # geom_hline(yintercept=15.91, linetype="dashed") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)

print(plot1)

ggsave("bar.pdf", plot1, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# 1. Prepare the data
# Using the values from our previous calculations and your tables
df <- data.frame(
  dataset = rep(c("Spontaneous (CANDOR)", "Planned (LibriTTS)"), each = 12),
  parse_type = rep(rep(c("Brackets", "Full Parse"), each = 6), 2),
  condition = rep(c("H(S)", "H(S|W)", "H(S|P_p)", "H(S|W,P_p)", "H(S|P_d)", "H(S|W,P_d)"), 4),
  nats_seq = c(
    # CANDOR Bracketing
    13.9, 2.83, 12.7, 3.03, 12.4, 3.06,
    # CANDOR Full Parse
    37.2, 5.25, 35.1, 5.31, 33.7, 5.27,
    # LibriTTS Bracketing (using averages we calculated)
    16.9, 5.76, 15.6, 6.77, 15.60, 6.71, 
    # LibriTTS Full Parse
    48.2, 13.7, 46.2, 13.8, 46.6, 13.6
  ),
  stdev = c(
    # Placeholders for CANDOR (replace with actuals if available)
    0.05, 0.07, 0.04, 0.06, 0.04, 0.06,
    0.11, 0.03, 0.10, 0.04, 0.09, 0.05,
    # LibriTTS calculated stdevs
    0.15, 0.137, 0.100, 0.19, 0.185, 0.18,
    0.64, 0.18, 1.51, 1.78, 0.3, 0.44
  )
)

df$condition <- factor(df$condition, levels = c("H(S)", "H(S|P_p)", "H(S|P_d)", "H(S|W)", "H(S|W,P_p)", "H(S|W,P_d)"))
df$dataset <- factor(df$dataset, levels = c("Spontaneous (CANDOR)", "Planned (LibriTTS)"))
df$parse_type <- factor(df$parse_type, levels = c("Brackets", "Full Parse"))

plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x = condition, y = nats_seq, fill = condition)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = nats_seq - stdev, ymax = nats_seq + stdev),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ dataset + parse_type, ncol = 4, scales = "free_y") +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "H(S)" = "#888888",
    "H(S|W)" = "#556B8F",
    "H(S|P_p)" = "#E28F41",
    "H(S|P_d)" = "#4E9C81",
    "H(S|W,P_p)" = "#D95F02",
    "H(S|W,P_d)" = "#1B9E77"
  )) +
  
  # Force legend into a single horizontal row
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  
  labs(
    x = NULL, # Remove "Input Modality" label as legend explains it
    y = "Entropy (nats per sequence)",
    fill = "Input Condition"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#f0f0f0"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

print(plot)

ggsave("bar.pdf", plot, width = 8, height = 3, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)

# 1. Load the 4 CSV files
df_dur_np   <- read_csv("corr_candor_nopunct_candor_duration_nopunct.csv")
df_pause_np <- read_csv("corr_candor_nopunct_candor_pause_nopunct.csv")
df_pause_dk <- read_csv("corr_candor_dyck_candor_pause_dyck.csv")
df_dur_dk   <- read_csv("corr_candor_dyck_candor_duration_dyck.csv")

# 2. Process subsets
process_subset <- function(df, modality, task) {
  df %>%
    select(word_count, parse_depth, sic) %>%
    mutate(Modality = modality, Task = task)
}

clean_dur_np   <- process_subset(df_dur_np,   "Dur", "Full parse")
clean_pause_np <- process_subset(df_pause_np, "Pau",    "Full parse")
clean_pause_dk <- process_subset(df_pause_dk, "Pau",    "Brackets")
clean_dur_dk   <- process_subset(df_dur_dk,   "Dur", "Brackets")

# Combine into one master dataframe
all_conditions <- bind_rows(clean_dur_np, clean_pause_np, clean_pause_dk, clean_dur_dk)

# 3. Create a downsampled version ONLY for the background scatter points
# This keeps the plot crisp, readable, and lightweight!
set.seed(42)
points_sample <- all_conditions %>%
  group_by(Modality, Task) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 10000) %>% # 10k points per condition = 40k total points
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(word_count, parse_depth),
    names_to = "Metric_Type",
    values_to = "X_Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric_Type = if_else(Metric_Type == "word_count", "Sent length (words)", "Max parse depth")
  )

# 4. Format the full dataset for the smooth lines layer
lines_data <- all_conditions %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(word_count, parse_depth),
    names_to = "Metric_Type",
    values_to = "X_Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric_Type = if_else(Metric_Type == "word_count", "Sent length (words)", "Max parse depth")
  )

```

```{r}
academic_colors <- c("Pau" = "#E28F41", "Dur" = "#4E9C81")

g <- ggplot() +
  # LAYER 1: The Background Scatter Cloud (Using the downsample)
  # alpha = 0.02 makes overlapping points build up density naturally
  geom_point(data = points_sample, 
           aes(x = X_Value, y = sic, color = Modality, shape = Task), 
           alpha = 0.03, size = 0.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  # LAYER 2: The Main Linear Fit Lines (Using the full dataset)
  geom_smooth(data = lines_data, 
              aes(x = X_Value, y = sic, color = Modality, linetype = Task),
              method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, alpha = 0.3, size = 0.4) +
  
  # Structural Layout & Scales
  facet_wrap(~ Metric_Type, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_color_manual(values = academic_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Full parse" = 16, "Brackets" = 17)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Full parse" = "solid", "Brackets" = "dashed")) +
  
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-10, 15)) +
  
  # Labels and Guides
  labs(
    x = "CANDOR sentence features",
    y = expression(paste(iota, "(s) -", iota, "(s | p) in nats")),
    # color = "Prosodic feature",
    # linetype = "Parse type",
    color = "",
    linetype = ""
  ) +
  
  # Style Guidelines
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) + 
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#f8f9fa", color = "#dee2e6"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, color = "#212529"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#f1f3f5"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.margin = margin(t = -5, b = 5),
  ) +
  guides(linetype = guide_legend(
                                 override.aes = list(color = "#2c3e50", size = 0.5))
  )

# Preview and save
print(g)
ggsave("candor_sic_with_scatterplot.pdf", plot = g, width = 4, height = 3, dpi = 300)

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# 1. Prepare master data with human-readable facet labels
lines_data_labeled <- lines_data %>%
  mutate(
    Metric_Type = case_when(
      grepl("word", tolower(Metric_Type)) ~ "Sent length (words)",
      grepl("depth", tolower(Metric_Type)) ~ "Max parse depth",
      TRUE ~ Metric_Type
    )
  )

# 2. Filter to zoomed bounds: 0-50 for words, 0-30 for parse depth
lines_data_filtered <- lines_data_labeled %>%
  filter(
    (Metric_Type == "Sent length (words)" & X_Value >= 0 & X_Value <= 50) |
    (Metric_Type == "Max parse depth" & X_Value >= 0 & X_Value <= 30)
  )

# 3. Compute binned empirical means & 95% CIs
binned_data <- lines_data_filtered %>%
  mutate(X_Bin = round(X_Value)) %>%
  group_by(Metric_Type, Modality, Task, X_Bin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sic = mean(sic, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_sic   = sd(sic, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    count    = n(),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(count >= 10) %>%
  mutate(
    ci_lower = mean_sic - 1.96 * se_sic,
    ci_upper = mean_sic + 1.96 * se_sic
  )

# 4. Plotting
academic_colors <- c("Pau" = "#E28F41", "Dur" = "#4E9C81")

g <- ggplot() +
  # Empirical Binned Means + 95% CIs
  geom_pointrange(
    data = binned_data,
    aes(x = X_Bin, y = mean_sic, ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper, color = Modality, shape = Task),
    size = 0.3, alpha = 0.6, position = position_dodge(width = 0.4), show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  # Linear Regression Lines
  geom_smooth(
    data = lines_data_filtered,
    aes(x = X_Value, y = sic, color = Modality, linetype = Task),
    method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, alpha = 0.15, size = 0.6
  ) +

  # Faceting & Aesthetics
  facet_wrap(~ Metric_Type, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_color_manual(values = academic_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Full parse" = 16, "Brackets" = 17)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Full parse" = "solid", "Brackets" = "dashed")) +

  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1, 8)) +

  labs(
    x = "CANDOR Sentence Features",
    y = expression(
      atop(
        "Pointwise Syntactic Information Content",
        paste(iota, "(s) - ", iota, "(s | p), in nats")
      )
    ),
    
    color = "",
    linetype = ""
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + 
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#f8f9fa", color = "#dee2e6"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, color = "#212529"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#f1f3f5"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.margin = margin(t = -5, b = 5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10)
  ) +
  guides(
    linetype = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = "#2c3e50", size = 0.6))
  )

print(g)
ggsave("candor_sic_binned.pdf", plot = g, width = 4, height = 3, dpi = 300)

```
